videos.role: visual structure contrast; June upload, not proof of current growth
videos.observation: Actual game scene from 0s, character close-up/emotion word at 4s, creation UI at 6s, selection UI at 10s, changing daily-life scenes through 14–30s, cooking UI at 36s, game title at 43s. Description contains a game-download link; full in-frame CTA wording unresolved.

limitations: Views are cumulative public display snapshots, not growth slopes or native analytics.
Shelf baseline is rounded, not age-matched, and mixes subjects/formats; ratios are descriptive, not causal.
Storyboards are sparse 101x180 thumbnails sampled about once per second; continuous motion, beat synchronization, full narration, precise cut counts and perceived pacing remain unverified.
No copied footage or audio is authorized for ProjectP production; only structural hypotheses are transferred.

adaptationFor146.opening: One true constraint → immediate fixed-camera before/after → face/detail close-up → feet/full-frame/motion comparison.
adaptationFor146.chapters: Use a small question/comparison → reason for change → visible result in each 15–30s passage; adjust to actual material and reading time.
adaptationFor146.spoilers: Show design changes and short isolated actions; omit puzzle solutions, exact operation order, later correct routes and exits.
